specs.name: CPU
specs.value: Dual-core 32-bit RISC-V, up to 400 MHz; single-core 32-bit LP RISC-V, up to 40 MHz

specs.name: RAM
specs.value: 768 KB HP L2MEM + 32 KB LP SRAM + 8 KB SPM; 32MB in-package PSRAM

specs.name: WiFi/BT
specs.value: WiFi 6, Bluetooth LE 5 (optional, ESP32-C6 is not mounted by default)

specs.name: 4G/LTE
specs.value: Internal Cat 1 4G/LTE module, not mounted by default

specs.name: Audio
specs.value: 3.5mm headset jack (audio out + headset microphone in); internal dual-channel speaker; front microphone

specs.name: GPIO
specs.value: 0 x GPIO (default), 8 x GPIO (optional, by configuring 2 x RS232, 1 x RS485 and 1 x CAN to 8 x GPIO)

specs.name: Relay
specs.value: 0 x relay (default), 1 x relay with “Normally Closed” and “Normally Open” output (optional), relay NC and NO can be configured from 1 x CAN

specs.name: RS232
specs.value: 2 x RS232 (default); RS232_2 can be configured to RS485 (optional); 2 x RS232 can be configured to 4 x GPIO (optional)

specs.name: RS485
specs.value: 1 x RS485 (default); up to 2 x RS485 (optional, by configuring RS232_2 to RS485); 1 x RS485 can be configured to 2 x GPIO (optional), 120Ohm terminal resistor is not mounted by default, if you need it, please note us

specs.name: CAN
specs.value: 1 x CAN (default), CAN 2.0 (classic CAN, no CAN FD), up to 1Mbps, 120Ohm terminal resistor is not mounted by default, if you need it, please note us; 1 x CAN can by configured to 1 x relay (optional)

specs.name: USB
specs.value: 2 x USB 2.0 Type-A high-speed host ports; 1 x USB 1.1 Type-C port for firmware flashing and debugging; the type-C port supports powering the device while programming

specs.name: RTC
specs.value: High-accuracy RTC with supercapacitor, can work 1 week after power off (default). High accuracy RTC with lithium coin battery, can work 3 years after power off (optional).
